prompt: Assess this captured gameplay frame conservatively. Mark an assertion uncertain when the frame does not contain enough visual evidence.

assertions.description: A coherent game scene is rendered rather than a blank, corrupt, or uninitialized frame.
No fatal error, crash dialog, missing-content message, or blocking loading overlay is visible.
Any visible HUD or interaction text is legible and not obviously clipped or corrupted; use uncertain if no HUD text is present.
